{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print only the number that will be reported
print(mean_revenue)"}
